title: Get S Working End to End
description: Get s working end to end. Dev build fails because framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs WindowMeasure::Slider, UiTreeSectionNode, UiButtonNode, UiSectionNode, and UiTreeNode initializers are missing the new waiting field after waiting-state was mirrored through React controls/trees/wgpu chrome. Fix compile and confirm bun run dev:s (or equivalent) builds plugins end to end.
summary: Fixed OS studio (`dev:s` / SEMIO_PLUGIN=s) end-to-end build. Root cause: `waiting: Option<bool>` added to UI nodes and WindowMeasure::Slider without updating plugin/module initializers; studio mode builds all plugins so one miss blocked everything. Added waiting: None across framework helpers and guest plugins, plus related struct gaps (group_labels, slider ready/loading, diff_view/event_feed, drop_overlay, SceneQuery import, DAG catalogue kinds). Verified with SEMIO_PLUGIN=s bun ./script.ts build in framework/product/os/dev (exit 0, 35 plugin modules packaged including s).
